links.outcome: Sensitivity and accuracy of junior residents alone, AI alone, and residents with AI assistance for ICH detection
links.effect: AI sensitivity 88.8%, junior residents 85.7%; with AI assistance combined sensitivity 95.2% and overall accuracy 98.8%. AI detected two of three ICH cases missed by residents.
links.quote: When AI assistance was integrated, the combined sensitivity improved to 95.2%, and the overall accuracy reached 98.8%.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the clinical diagnostic accuracy of a commercial AI tool on trauma head CTs alone and in combination with junior resident interpretation compared to the resident alone.

primary.practice: AI assistance to junior resident radiologist review
